# Examples

One folder per TV model, each with a `debloat.txt` listing the packages that are safe to disable
on that firmware, grouped and commented. These are starting points: comment out anything you use.

- [JMGO N5s Pro](../docs/devices/jmgo-n5s-pro.md), China, 坚果 N5s Pro / `K990CN`, JMGO LunaOS on Android 11 (`K990CN-userdebug ... 1.1.31.7 dev-keys`), MediaTek: the ADB trigger is pressing OK repeatedly on About → System version (no build-number unlock), and `ro.adb.secure=0` opens port 5555 with no on-TV confirmation; the China preload set is mapped next to the N1S `holan` Google TV list it must not be confused with, and the reference launcher's install, Home handover and full revert are verified; no debloat list yet.
- [Mtek MK32CS1NB](../docs/devices/mtek-mk32cs1nb.md) (32", CVTE `TP.MT5510I.PB801`, MediaTek MT5863, Android 7.0 / SDK 24 `20171230_042214`, stock `com.cvte.tv.launcher`): no Developer options, so ADB comes from CVTE's factory menu, and the USB port serves `adb` only until debugging is switched off and the set is unplugged from the wall; a `minSdk 24` fork with core library desugaring and four API-26+ calls replaced is what runs the launcher there, and HDMI 1 to 3 (`HW4` to `HW6`) switch only through `com.cvte.tv.androidsetting/.TvSettingActivity` with `MTK_EXTRA_INPUT_ID` rather than the launcher's `input_sources` route; no debloat list.

- [SDMC SMART4KTVPLUS (WhaleTV)](../docs/devices/sdmc-whaletv-smart4ktvplus.md) (Madagascar, `at30ak`, Android 13 `WHALEOS-C8W-S2C.A1744.4K`, firmware dated 2026-06-10): the launcher half is impossible, PackageManager refuses every APK not signed by Zeasn ("mismatched zeasn certificates", HOME or not) and `pm install` answers "user version can't use 'adb install'"; the stock `com.whaletv.launcher` also holds the only app store; one-session list of 24 disabled packages (Zeasn tracking and device portal, unused streaming and phone apps); the boot-time Netflix "system ID" dialog is the unit's, not the list's.
- [Hisense HiSmart 2K ATV4](../docs/devices/hisense-hismart-2k-atv4-hamamatsucho.md) (`hamamatsucho`, Hisense, Android TV 11 `RTO6.250817.001`, 924 MB, armeabi-v7a only): the Android 11 sibling of the Vu Premium `Smart 2K ATV4` on the same board, and 10 of the 16 packages in `hisense-hismarttv-a4-android11/` are absent here; the input-driver guard holds back four packages as NOCHK because this firmware prints no `requested permissions:` block, and `pm query-services --components -a android.media.tv.TvInputService` is what settles it; the launcher's Home handover and `InputKeyService` survived one cold reboot; no several-day debloat list.

run the prompt in [PROMPT.md](../PROMPT.md) and copy the packages your assistant disabled.
